info.title: CurrencyKit - ECB Exchange Rates & Currency Converter
info.description:
# CurrencyKit: ECB Exchange Rates and Currency Converter API

Official European Central Bank euro reference rates for about 30 currencies, re-based to any of them: latest rates, conversion, any date back to 1999, and daily time series. Simple JSON, no scraping, consistent with what auditors and tax authorities expect.

**Who it's for:** e-commerce checkouts and price displays, invoicing and accounting tools, finance dashboards, travel and expense apps, and EU VAT/OSS reporting that must use ECB rates.

## Use cases
- Show prices in a shopper's currency with an official daily rate.
- Convert invoices at the ECB rate for the invoice date.
- Revalue balances at month-end with a reproducible public rate.
- Chart a currency pair over the past year.
- Use ECB rates for EU VAT One Stop Shop (OSS) returns, which require them.

## Quickstart
Subscribe on RapidAPI (a free plan is available), copy your key, then:

```bash
curl --request GET \
  --url 'https://currencykit-ecb-exchange-rates-currency-converter.p.rapidapi.com/latest?base=EUR&symbols=USD,GBP,JPY' \
  --header 'X-RapidAPI-Key: YOUR_RAPIDAPI_KEY' \
  --header 'X-RapidAPI-Host: currencykit-ecb-exchange-rates-currency-converter.p.rapidapi.com'
```

## Authentication
Every request goes through RapidAPI. Send `X-RapidAPI-Key` (your key) and `X-RapidAPI-Host` (`currencykit-ecb-exchange-rates-currency-converter.p.rapidapi.com`) on every call. Requests that bypass the gateway are rejected with `403`.

## Good to know
- Rates update once per business day around 16:00 CET; responses are cached for up to 30 minutes after a new fixing.
- No intraday or crypto rates: these are daily reference rates, published by the ECB for information purposes and not for transaction use.
- Dates are ISO 8601 (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Weekends and TARGET holidays resolve to the closest earlier fixing; `date` always tells you which one was used.
- Cross rates (non-EUR base) are computed through the euro and rounded to 8 significant digits.

## Rate limits and plans
Request quotas and per-second limits depend on the RapidAPI plan you subscribe to; see the Pricing tab. When a limit is reached the gateway returns `429 Too Many Requests`; retry with exponential backoff or move to a higher plan.

## Errors
All errors are JSON. The API returns `{"error": "<reason>"}` with a meaningful HTTP status: `404` not found, `422` missing or invalid parameter, `503` temporarily unavailable, retry shortly. Gateway errors (`401`/`403`/`429`) come from RapidAPI as `{"message": "<reason>"}`.

## Data sources and licences
- Exchange rates: European Central Bank euro foreign exchange reference rates (https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html). Free reuse with source acknowledgement; the ECB publishes them for information purposes only.

## MCP (AI agents)
This API is also available as a Model Context Protocol server at `POST /mcp` on the same RapidAPI host; see the MCP endpoint for setup.

get.summary: Get the latest ECB reference rates
get.description: Returns the most recent ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates (published around 16:00 CET on TARGET business days), re-based to any of the ~30 available currencies. Filter the response with `symbols`.

parameters.name: base
parameters.description: Base currency the rates are quoted against (3-letter ISO 4217 code, case-insensitive. See /currencies.) Defaults to EUR.

parameters.name: symbols
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated list of target currencies (max 50), e.g. `USD,GBP,JPY`. Omit for all available currencies.

example.note: ECB reference rates are published for information purposes only, around 16:00 CET on TARGET business days. Not for transaction use.
example.source: European Central Bank euro foreign exchange reference rates (https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html)

422.description: Unknown currency, bad date or invalid amount.

example.error: from XYZ is not available for this date. See /currencies
ECB reference rates are temporarily unavailable, retry shortly

get.description: Converts an amount from one currency to another using the latest ECB reference rate, or the rate for a past `date` (the closest earlier ECB business day if that date had no fixing). Cross rates are computed through the euro.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: Amount to convert. Defaults to 1. Negative values are allowed (e.g. refunds).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Source currency (3-letter ISO 4217 code, case-insensitive. See /currencies.)

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Target currency (3-letter ISO 4217 code, case-insensitive. See /currencies.)

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Optional historical date, YYYY-MM-DD (1999-01-04 onward). Omit for the latest rate.

example.source: European Central Bank euro foreign exchange reference rates (https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html)

422.description: Unknown currency, bad date or invalid amount.

example.error: from XYZ is not available for this date. See /currencies
ECB reference rates are temporarily unavailable, retry shortly

get.summary: Get reference rates for a past date
get.description: Returns the ECB reference rates for a date since 1999-01-04. Weekends and TARGET holidays resolve to the closest earlier business day: `requested_date` echoes your input and `date` is the fixing used. Includes legacy currencies (e.g. EEK, LTL, HRK) for dates when the ECB quoted them.

parameters.name: base
parameters.description: Base currency the rates are quoted against (3-letter ISO 4217 code, case-insensitive. See /currencies.) Defaults to EUR.

parameters.name: symbols
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated list of target currencies (max 50), e.g. `USD,GBP,JPY`. Omit for all available currencies.

example.note: If the requested date was a weekend or TARGET holiday, the closest earlier ECB business day is used.
example.source: European Central Bank euro foreign exchange reference rates (https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html)

404.description: No ECB fixing on or before that date.

example.error: No ECB reference rate on or before that date

422.description: Unknown currency, bad date or invalid amount.

example.error: from XYZ is not available for this date. See /currencies
ECB reference rates are temporarily unavailable, retry shortly

get.summary: Get daily rates between two dates
get.description: Returns the daily ECB reference rates for every business day between `start` and `end` (inclusive, up to 366 days per call), re-based and filtered like /latest. Use it for charts, month-end revaluation and back-testing. Days without a fixing are simply absent.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Last date, YYYY-MM-DD, on or after `start` and at most 366 days later.

parameters.name: base
parameters.description: Base currency the rates are quoted against (3-letter ISO 4217 code, case-insensitive. See /currencies.) Defaults to EUR.

parameters.name: symbols
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated list of target currencies (max 50), e.g. `USD,GBP,JPY`. Omit for all available currencies.

example.source: European Central Bank euro foreign exchange reference rates (https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html)

422.description: Unknown currency, bad date or invalid amount.

example.error: from XYZ is not available for this date. See /currencies
ECB reference rates are temporarily unavailable, retry shortly

get.description: Lists the currencies in the latest ECB fixing with their English names, plus legacy currencies that appear only in older data (usable with /historical and /timeseries for those dates).

example.note: historical_only lists currencies that appear only in older ECB data (e.g. pre-euro national currencies); /historical and /timeseries accept them for dates when they were quoted.
example.source: European Central Bank euro foreign exchange reference rates (https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html)

example.error: ECB reference rates are temporarily unavailable, retry shortly

Error.description: Error body. Errors raised by the API itself carry an `error` string. Errors raised by the RapidAPI gateway (missing or invalid key, not subscribed, quota or rate limit exceeded) carry a `message` string instead.

rates.description: Map of currency code to units of that currency per 1 unit of `base` (8 significant digits).

note.description: Usage note on ECB reference rates.

date.description: Fixing date actually used (same or closest earlier business day).

rates.description: Map of currency code to units of that currency per 1 unit of `base` (8 significant digits).

note.description: How weekends and holidays are resolved.

result.description: amount x rate, rounded to 6 decimals.

requested_date.description: Historical date requested, or null for latest.

rates.description: Map of fixing date (YYYY-MM-DD) to a map of currency code to rate.

additionalProperties.description: Map of currency code to units of that currency per 1 unit of `base` (8 significant digits).

historical_only.description: Legacy currencies found only in older fixings: code to name.
